title: 19-BCV-001R1 - Relocatable industrial accommodation labeling

facts.text: The revision recognizes CSA A277 certification in place of Alberta labelling for new Part 10 relocatable industrial camp buildings.
The variance cites Division C Sentence 2.4.5.1.(3) and Division B Sentence 10.1.1.4.(3) in describing the prior certification and Alberta-label requirements.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-001R1 PDF, p. 1, Discussion and Code References

facts.text: For construction under Part 10 on or after December 16, 2019, the variance accepts the applicable CSA A277 certification label and specification sheet; in-situ renovations require AHJ permits and follow separate label directions.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
